name: Phang benchmark
description: Supporting data for: Pang SJL, Yap EPH. Phang: a desktop application for bacteriophage genome characterisation and therapy-candidate screening (submitted to Microbial Genomics). Phang itself is a separate archive: source code, documentation and the macOS and Windows installers are at https://github.com/seanpang49/Phang-app, and the version described in the article is release v0.2.8. This archive holds everything needed to check the benchmark reported in the article: the 35-genome control panel with the source and quoted evidence behind every reference label, the synthetic titration constructs and the scripts that built them, the result tables, the per-genome Pharokka and Phold annotations the analyses read, and the scripts that turn those into the published numbers. A README documents the contents and gives the commands that reproduce each reported result.
